title: Text goes off screen edge on xDrip(BigChart) watchface with 12-hr time & round screen.
body:
![0804170232](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/30334744/28963373-c404bb16-78bd-11e7-8720-8c8ce050e78d.jpg)

I suggest removing " AM" altogether so it matches the position of military time.

comments.body: @kskandispersonal what do you think about this suggestion? How easy would it be to implement for round screens?
@jamorham I think this would be resolved if the user enables 24hr format in XDrip Prefs, as @geor9 suggested.
